hook_text: Accountants have one rule they never break. Once you know it, debits and credits stop being scary.
clip_script: Every transaction tells two stories. The owner adds ten thousand rand: the bank grows, and the owner's capital grows. Write both. Bank on the left, debit. Capital on the right, credit. Same amount. Pay three thousand rand wages: wages grow on the left, bank shrinks on the right. Two teams. Team debit grows on the left: assets, expenses, drawings. Team credit grows on the right: capital, liabilities, income. To grow, write on your own side. To shrink, write on the other. Money in? Bank left. Money out? Bank right. Every left has a matching right, so the whole ledger always balances.
visual_style: A whiteboard of T-shaped folders, two teams of labels lining up on each side, and coins sliding left and right in matching pairs.
mood: Reassuring and clever, a rule that unlocks everything.
pacing: One big rule, two quick examples, a team sort, and a confident finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and analyse April's transactions yourself.
